chapter: The union and the 1920s-30s band scene
title: Leading Los Angeles bandleaders: Les Hite, Cee Pee Johnson and others
summary: Howard struggles to name the best bandleaders he knew beyond Les Hite; Collette prompts with Floyd Ray, C. L. Burke and Cee Pee Johnson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: The best band leaders that I knew, and that's me
speaking, Paul Howard, that went from one place to the other that I know of, were Les Hite was one of them, and the other one was --that word won't come out of my mind. Hold it up, Buddy.
That's all right, go ahead. You've got time.
Have I got the time?
Oh, yeah, we've got time for you.
Okay. I'm trying to --
I know Les Hite was one of them because he was one of the ones I admired, too.
Sure.
But there must have been somebody other than Floyd.
Floyd.
Floyd Ray.
I didn't pay any attention to him. Well, the only one that I know of of these band leaders that was a good one, and that one is -- you know, it's kind of hard to think of some of this.
Yeah, right. It wasn't C. L. Burke, was it?
Oh, no.
Okay.
But he had a nice little following.
And it wasn't Cee Pee Johnson.
No, no.
(Laughter)
I'm just helping you to think.
That's good. Cee Pee was a knockout.
Yes.
He was a guy that would tear up the place.
(Laughter)
Don't we know.
Sure, you know that.
Yeah, I worked with him, yeah.
Yeah.
I would say Les Hite, but there had to be others.
There were some others.
Yeah.
Who were some of the other bands that were working around that same time?
That's what I'm trying to think of.
Wouldn't have to be the most outstanding. We can get back to that part.
Yeah, if we can just get some names down. Now, later came George Brown and Al Adams, but this is in the early '40s. But before that there had to be some bands in Los Angeles.
Oh, sure.
Who did Marshall Royal and the guys play with, other than Les Hite and Lloyd Reese and --
Well, --
Leo Davis had a big band, didn't he?
No.
He didn't?
Uh-uh. But he played in big bands. But I'll have to go back and --

You'll have to think of something. You probably have pictures and names of some of these people, though, because I know there were some bands. When we came up there, bands there were George Brown, Les Hite, Floyd Ray, Al Adams. But the bands before that is what we can't think of.
They just won't stay in my mind. Can I take a rain check on it?
Sure, right. But if you think of --
